paris.songTitle: The Ballad of John and Yoko
paris.line: Finally, made the plane into Paris
stanza: Finally, made the plane into Paris
Peter Brown called to say, “You can make it okay
You can get married in Gibraltar, near Spain”
More room for you and more room for me
And every city the whole world 'round
Will just be another American town
You wear a Japanese kimono, babe
There'll be Italian shoes for me
So let's drop the big one now
Let's drop the big one now
